name: RoboSpatialHome
description: RoboSpatialHome evaluates spatial understanding for robotic home navigation and manipulation. It tests vision-language models on real-world spatial reasoning tasks drawn from home environments, assessing understanding of object positions, spatial relations, and navigation-relevant spatial concepts needed for embodied AI agents.
typical_sota_score: ~50–70% (current multimodal models; spatial reasoning for robotics remains challenging)
reputation: Specialized spatial reasoning benchmark for robotics contexts; designed to bridge gap between vision-language model evaluation and real-world robotic deployment requirements
notes: Part of the RoboSpatial benchmark family targeting real-world spatial understanding for robotic applications. The Home subset focuses on indoor home environment scenarios relevant to domestic robot deployment.
